## TemplateEngine.\_processGPrecheckoutErrorBlocks() method

Block: g-precheckout-error Extracts `<g-precheckout-error>` plain-text blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processGPrecheckoutErrorBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: string;
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[lang: string\]: string; }

An object mapping language keys to their raw text content

## Remarks

Children form only; content is cleaned exactly like `<g-message>` and keyed by `lang` (`"default"` when absent; last block wins per lang). Raw content is preserved verbatim (including `{{var|filter}}` spans) for later compilation. Plain-text rules are enforced by `validateBlockGPrecheckoutErrorAttributes`<!-- -->, not here.

## Example


```typescript
const blocks = TemplateEngine._processGPrecheckoutErrorBlocks(`<g-precheckout-error>Stok {{item}} habis</g-precheckout-error>`);
// Result: { default: 'Stok {{item}} habis' }
```
